unresolved_candidate.description: The visible exchange does not conclusively determine whether geometry, graphs, measurements, division, and fractions belong in Grade 2.
The 0–20, 20–50, and 50–100 sorting ranges are presented as an example or preference, so it is unclear whether those exact boundaries are mandatory.
Conveyor-belt setup and player interaction may represent independently requested interaction behavior, but the visible evidence is only a freelancer implementation claim without client confirmation.
The proposed value of six to eight levels per topic receives no visible client answer and cannot safely be established as a Requirement value.
All-grade coverage is established, but the exact first and last grades included in that range are not specified in the visible messages.
